opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Marina
opponents.meet_text: Have you ever seen a Pikachu Surf, Some are really really good on a surfboard!!
opponents.repeat_text: Have you seen a Pikachu on a surfboard yet?
opponents.first_win_text: If you haven't seen a Pikachu use surf you can have this then!
opponents.rematch_win_text: I wish I could surf like a Pikachu
opponents.loss_text: Pikachu can do everything, it's the best!!!

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Skye
opponents.meet_text: Some Pokemon can use fly to take you somewhere you want to go. Turns out so can Pikachu!
opponents.repeat_text: I want to take a ride on a flying Pikachu
opponents.first_win_text: Hold onto this and try not to float away!
opponents.rematch_win_text: I've never see a flying Pikachu
opponents.loss_text: You'll never catch a Pikachu that's flying away!

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Cami
opponents.meet_text: I love taking pictures of Pokemon, especially Pikachu!
opponents.repeat_text: I'm really good with a Camera!
opponents.first_win_text: I took a really good picture of Pikachu and put it on this card
opponents.rematch_win_text: Do you want to see more pictures of Pikachu?
opponents.loss_text: I'll have to take a photo to remember this moment

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Juniper
opponents.meet_text: Did you know Pikachu live in the forest?
opponents.repeat_text: I've not seen any Pikachu around here yet.
opponents.first_win_text: I wish I could find a Pikachu around here but this is all I can find.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Have you found a Pikachu around here yet?
opponents.loss_text: If I'm lucky enough to win then I should be lucky enough to see a Pikachu!

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Raye
opponents.meet_text: Go Pikachu, use Thunderbolt!!!.... I don't really have a Pikachu.
opponents.repeat_text: I wish I could have a Pikachu for real
opponents.first_win_text: Have this Pikachu card and if you get a real Pikachu can you let me have it?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I still don't have a Pikachu at all
opponents.loss_text: My Pikachu would be really strong too!

opponents.name: Pikachu Fan Leaf
opponents.meet_text: Pikachu is just so cute, he's the cutest Pokemon ever!
opponents.first_win_text: Even though I don't have a lot of Pikachu, you can have this one.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I will win with my Pikachu one day!
opponents.loss_text: That's why I love Pikachu so much!

opponents.name: Youngster Milo
opponents.meet_text: I've not been playing the TCG for long but I think I'm really good already.
opponents.repeat_text: I'm getting better all the time.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm not as good as I thought.
opponents.loss_text: I told you I was really good!

opponents.name: Pikachu Mum
opponents.meet_text: Thank you for getting them all to come back and stay here, I don't know the rules very well of this game but I'll play you as a thanks!
opponents.repeat_text: Want to see all of my Pikachu again?
opponents.first_win_text: As a thank you again, take these!
opponents.rematch_win_text: My kids could learn a lot from you
opponents.loss_text: I didn't know Pikachu could be so strong!

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Proton
opponents.meet_text: This well is bringing back a lot of memories... I can't imagine you've heard of Team Rocket before but you'll hear about us soon.
opponents.first_win_text: Heh we're in your shadow then huh.
opponents.rematch_win_text: It won't always be like this.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Petrel
opponents.meet_text: Heh, you've found us at the right time. We've been hiding from the police... Not that we've done anything illegal, we're just here to play this card game.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You should join us, we've got big things coming.
opponents.loss_text: Of course you didn't stand a chance against us.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Archer
opponents.meet_text: Hello. I'm Archer one of the 4 execs of Team Rocket. We're not here to do anything illicit. Not yet anyway. We're just getting started.
opponents.repeat_text: If you're really that interested you should join us.
opponents.first_win_text: Enjoy the wins while they last.

opponents.name: Forest Ranger Tucker
opponents.meet_text: There's a lot of poisonous Pokemon out here in the trees so you have to be careful when you're wandering off the paths.
opponents.first_win_text: You can clearly handle yourself so you should be fine.
opponents.loss_text: You might need to report to first aid...

opponents.name: Youngster Cooper
opponents.meet_text: Have you ever seen a pokemon EXPLODE before? It's CRAZY!
opponents.repeat_text: I PROMISE I haven't blown anything up!!
opponents.rematch_win_text: I feel like I'm going to explode

opponents.name: Clown Hubert
opponents.meet_text: Can you believe that some people are actually scared of us clowns!!!
opponents.repeat_text: I'm glad you don't find me scary!
opponents.first_win_text: I ran away from the circus for this?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I wonder if the circus will take me back....
opponents.loss_text: *honk* *honk* I can teach you how to ride a unicycle

opponents.name: Clown Glenn
opponents.meet_text: Why do clowns often have stiff necks?....
opponents.repeat_text: I told my wife I was going to clown college....
opponents.rematch_win_text: ..... She said you can't be serious!!!

opponents.name: Young Sage Kai
opponents.meet_text: Have you ever tried meditating in the forest? The atmosphere is perfect for it.
opponents.repeat_text: Hope you're taking it easy out here.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm going to try and reconnect with nature.

opponents.name: Backpacker Patrick
opponents.meet_text: I've been all over the world and seen a lot of different places.
opponents.repeat_text: Nothing like putting on a backpack and going exploring
opponents.loss_text: Carrying all this weight makes me stronger in every sense

opponents.name: Hiker Walter
opponents.meet_text: I've been travelling for hours, for days on end. I hike everywhere. It's a lot of hard work but I see a lot.
opponents.repeat_text: My legs are still aching, need a rest.
opponents.first_win_text: I should have taken my hiking backpack off, I couldn't concentrate.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm still too focused on the hike and not the game.
opponents.loss_text: If you hike everywhere like me you learn how to do a lot.

opponents.name: Nature Lover Erin
opponents.meet_text: I absolutely love the forest in the day, it's my favourite spot to hang out.
opponents.repeat_text: Nothing like being out in the open air hey?
opponents.first_win_text: Nothing can bring me down when I'm in such a good mood.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You don't always have to go so hard, sometimes you can just relax.
opponents.loss_text: Take a moment to breathe and try again!
